consumers.name: agg_amenities_by_category
consumers.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM amenities GROUP BY category ORDER BY category LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_booking_updates_by_status
consumers.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(guests_count) AS total_guests_count FROM booking_updates GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_bookings_by_status
consumers.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(guests_count) AS total_guests_count FROM bookings GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_clickstream_by_event
consumers.sql: SELECT event, COUNT(*) AS n FROM clickstream GROUP BY event ORDER BY event LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_countries_by_country
consumers.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM countries GROUP BY country ORDER BY country LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_customer_support_logs_by_created_at
consumers.sql: SELECT created_at, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customer_support_logs GROUP BY created_at ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_destinations_by_destination
consumers.sql: SELECT destination, COUNT(*) AS n FROM destinations GROUP BY destination ORDER BY destination LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_employees_by_role
consumers.sql: SELECT role, COUNT(*) AS n FROM employees GROUP BY role ORDER BY role LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_hosts_by_country
consumers.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(rating) AS total_rating FROM hosts GROUP BY country ORDER BY country LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_page_views_by_device_type
consumers.sql: SELECT device_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM page_views GROUP BY device_type ORDER BY device_type LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_payments_by_payment_method
consumers.sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY payment_method LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_properties_by_title
consumers.sql: SELECT title, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(base_price) AS total_base_price FROM properties GROUP BY title ORDER BY title LIMIT 200

consumers.name: features_property_amenities_by_property_id
consumers.sql: SELECT property_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM property_amenities GROUP BY property_id ORDER BY property_id LIMIT 200

consumers.name: trend_property_images_sequence
consumers.sql: SELECT substr(CAST(uploaded_at AS STRING),1,7) AS month, SUM(sequence) AS total FROM property_images GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

consumers.name: trend_reviews_rating
consumers.sql: SELECT substr(CAST(created_at AS STRING),1,7) AS month, SUM(rating) AS total FROM reviews GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

consumers.name: agg_users_by_country
consumers.sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS n FROM users GROUP BY country ORDER BY country LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_amenities_by_icon
consumers.sql: SELECT icon, COUNT(*) AS n FROM amenities GROUP BY icon ORDER BY icon LIMIT 200

consumers.name: trend_booking_updates_guests_count
consumers.sql: SELECT substr(CAST(check_in AS STRING),1,7) AS month, SUM(guests_count) AS total FROM booking_updates GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

consumers.name: trend_bookings_guests_count
consumers.sql: SELECT substr(CAST(check_in AS STRING),1,7) AS month, SUM(guests_count) AS total FROM bookings GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

consumers.name: features_clickstream_by_property_id
consumers.sql: SELECT property_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(CAST(timestamp AS STRING)) AS last_seen FROM clickstream GROUP BY property_id ORDER BY property_id LIMIT 200

consumers.name: agg_countries_by_country_code
consumers.sql: SELECT country_code, COUNT(*) AS n FROM countries GROUP BY country_code ORDER BY country_code LIMIT 200

consumers.name: features_customer_support_logs_by_support_agent_id
consumers.sql: SELECT support_agent_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customer_support_logs GROUP BY support_agent_id ORDER BY support_agent_id LIMIT 200

consumers.name: join_booking_updates_bookings
consumers.sql: SELECT bookings.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(booking_updates.guests_count) AS total FROM booking_updates JOIN bookings ON booking_updates.booking_id = bookings.booking_id GROUP BY bookings.status ORDER BY bookings.status LIMIT 200

consumers.name: join_booking_updates_properties
consumers.sql: SELECT properties.title AS title, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(booking_updates.guests_count) AS total FROM booking_updates JOIN properties ON booking_updates.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.title ORDER BY properties.title LIMIT 200

consumers.name: join_booking_updates_users
consumers.sql: SELECT users.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(booking_updates.guests_count) AS total FROM booking_updates JOIN users ON booking_updates.user_id = users.user_id GROUP BY users.country ORDER BY users.country LIMIT 200

consumers.name: join_bookings_users
consumers.sql: SELECT users.country AS country, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(bookings.guests_count) AS total FROM bookings JOIN users ON bookings.user_id = users.user_id GROUP BY users.country ORDER BY users.country LIMIT 200

consumers.name: join_bookings_properties
consumers.sql: SELECT properties.title AS title, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(bookings.guests_count) AS total FROM bookings JOIN properties ON bookings.property_id = properties.property_id GROUP BY properties.title ORDER BY properties.title LIMIT 200

consumers.name: top_agg_amenities_by_category
consumers.sql: SELECT category, n FROM agg_amenities_by_category ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

consumers.name: top_agg_booking_updates_by_status
consumers.sql: SELECT status, n FROM agg_booking_updates_by_status ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

consumers.name: top_agg_bookings_by_status
consumers.sql: SELECT status, n FROM agg_bookings_by_status ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

consumers.name: top_agg_clickstream_by_event
consumers.sql: SELECT event, n FROM agg_clickstream_by_event ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

consumers.name: top_agg_countries_by_country
consumers.sql: SELECT country, n FROM agg_countries_by_country ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10

consumers.name: top_agg_customer_support_logs_by_created_at
consumers.sql: SELECT created_at, n FROM agg_customer_support_logs_by_created_at ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 10
